# Supply crate: a 0.6 m box with a darker lid band and a glowing label light. Up Z.
new
add mesh cube --name Box --size 1 --location 0 0 0.3
scale 0.6 0.6 0.56
apply --scale
material new Crate --base-color 0.537 0.635 0.341
add mesh cube --name Lid --size 1 --location 0 0 0.6
scale 0.66 0.66 0.12
apply --scale
material new Lid --base-color 0.188 0.365 0.259
add mesh cube --name Band --size 1 --location 0 0 0.25
scale 0.64 0.64 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Lid
select all
shade flat
export crate.glb
